name: Saffron Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Saffron Industries Limited is in the business of paper manufacturing and real estate development.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
a) SIL is engaged in manufacturing newsprint and kraft papers.
b) It has also ventured into real estate development after obtaining approvals to convert factory land from industrial to residential use.
c) A layout plan has been approved, development charges paid, and RERA registration obtained from Maharashtra RERA.
d) The factory land has been reclassified as stock-in-trade based on approvals.
e) The company signed MoUs with a few buyers and allotted plots accordingly; proceeds are treated as sales, though sale deeds are yet to be executed.

cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -6.47% over past five years.
